import html # Predefined HTML template for blog posts. # The placeholders {title} and {body} will be replaced with the # sanitized heading and description respectively. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog(heading: str, description: str) -> str: """ Prepare a blog post for safe web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main headline of the blog post. description : str The full textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML‑formatted blog post, ready for insertion into a web page. Raises ------ ValueError If either ``heading`` or ``description`` is not a string. """ if not isinstance(heading, str) or not isinstance(description, str): raise ValueError("Both heading and description must be strings") # Escape all characters that could create HTML or JavaScript payloads. safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) # For the body we allow line breaks to be preserved by converting # newline characters to
tags after escaping. escaped_body = html.escape(description, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') # Ensure the final HTML is well‑formed by substituting placeholders. formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=escaped_body) return formatted_post
